name: Second-Order Occlusion-Aware Volumetric Radiance Caching
definition: A radiance caching algorithm for participating media that uses second-order gradient analysis (Hessian) of light transport to adaptively sample and interpolate radiance from sparse cache points, accounting for occlusion changes.
summary: Second-Order Occlusion-Aware Volumetric Radiance Caching is a radiance caching algorithm that uses Hessian-based error metrics and proxy triangulation to accurately capture high-frequency shadow boundaries in participating media.
